# 4 Ezra Chapter 8 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Latin Vulgate (Codex Sangermanensis) | **Section:** Core apocalypse — Third dialogue

---

**8:1** And he-answered-me and-said: The-Most-High-made this-world for-the-sake-of-many, but-the-world-to-come for-the-sake-of-few.

**8:2** But-I will-tell-you a-parable, Ezra. As-when-you-ask-the-earth, it-says to-you: It-gives-much-loam from-which earthenware-is-made, but-little-dust from-which gold-comes — so-is-also-the-course-of-the-present-world.

**8:3** Many-are-created but-few-shall-be-saved.

**8:4** Then-I-answered and-said: Swallow then your-understanding, O-my-soul, and-let-your-heart devour-wisdom.

**8:5** For-without-your-will-you-came, and-against-your-will-you-depart; and-you-have-been-given-only-a-short-time-to-live.

**8:6** O-LORD above-us, suffer-your-servant to-pray-before-you, and-give-us a-seed-for-our-heart and-cultivation-of-the-understanding to-our-mind, so-that fruit-may-come-from-it by-which every-mortal who-bears-the-likeness-of-man-shall-be-able-to-live.

**8:7** For-you-alone-dost-exist and-we-are a-work-of-your-hands, as-you-have-declared.

**8:8** And-since-you-quicken the-body which-is-fashioned in-the-womb and-do-furnish-it with-members, your-creation-is-preserved in-fire-and-water, and-nine-months-does-your-workmanship-endure your-creature which-is-created in-it.

**8:9** But-that-which-keeps and-that-which-is-kept shall-both-be-kept-by-your-keeping; and-when-the-womb-delivers again-what-has-been-created-in-it,

**8:10** you-have-commanded that-out-of-the-parts-of-the-body, that-is-out-of-the-breasts, milk-the-fullness-of-breasts-shall-be-supplied,

**8:11** so-that the-thing-fashioned may-be-nourished for-a-time, and-afterwards you-direct-it-in-your-mercy.

**8:12** You-have-nourished-it in-your-righteousness and-disciplined-it in-your-law, and-reproved-it in-your-wisdom.

**8:13** You-will-take-it-away in-your-death and-you-will-let-it-live in-your-life.

**8:14** If-therefore you-will-destroy-him-who-with-so-great-labor-was-fashioned-by-your-command, to-what-purpose-was-he-made?

**8:15** And-now I-will-speak: Concerning-all-mankind you-know-best; but-I-will-speak-concerning-your-people, for-whom-I-am-grieved,

**8:16** and-concerning-your-inheritance, for-whom-I-mourn, and-concerning-Israel, for-whom-I-am-sad, and-concerning-the-seed-of-Jacob, for-whom-I-am-troubled:

**8:17** therefore-I-will-begin-to-pray before-you for-myself and-for-them; for-I-see-the-falls-of-us-who-dwell-in-the-land.

**8:18** But-I-have-heard the-swiftness-of-the-Judge who-is-to-come.

**8:19** Therefore-hear-my-voice and-understand-my-words, and-I-will-speak-before-you. [This is the beginning of-the-words-of-Ezra's prayer, before he-was-taken-up. And-he-said:]

**8:20** O-LORD, you-who-inhabit-eternity, whose-eyes-are-exalted-above-all and-are-looked-upon from-above:

**8:21** whose-throne is-beyond-all-measure of-thought, and-whose-glory-is-beyond-comprehension, before-whom-the-hosts-of-angels-stand-trembling,

**8:22** and-at-whose-bidding-they-are-changed-to-wind-and-fire: whose-word-is-sure-and-whose-utterances-are-constant, whose-commandment-is-strong-and-whose-ordinance-is-fearful,

**8:23** whose-look-dries-up-the-depths and-whose-indignation makes-the-mountains-melt-away, and-whose-truth-endures-for-ever:

**8:24** Hear, O-LORD, the-prayer-of-your-servant, and-give-ear to-the-petition-of-your-creature, and-attend-to-my-words.

**8:25** For-as-long-as-I-live-I-will-speak, and-as-long-as-I-am-understanding-I-will-answer.

**8:26** O-look-not-upon-the-sins-of-your-people, but-upon-those-who-have-served-you-in-truth.

**8:27** Take-no-account-of-the-endeavors-of-those-who-work-wickedness, but-of-the-endeavors-of-those-who-have-kept-your-covenants-amid-afflictions.

**8:28** Think-not-on-those-who-have-lived-wickedly-in-your-sight; but-remember-those-who-have-willingly-known-your-fear.

**8:29** Let-it-not-be-your-will-to-destroy-those-who-have-had-the-cattle-life; but-look-at-those-who-have-gloriously-taught-your-law.

**8:30** Take-no-displeasure-at-those-who-are-deemed-worse-than-beasts; but-love-those-who-have-always-put-their-trust-in-your-righteousness-and-glory.

**8:31** For-we-and-our-fathers-have-passed-our-lives-in-ways-that-bring-death; but-it-is-because-of-us-sinners-that-you-are-called-merciful.

**8:32** For-if-you-have-desire-to-have-mercy-on-us-who-have-no-works-of-righteousness, then-you-shall-be-called-merciful.

**8:33** For-the-righteous-who-have-many-works-laid-up-with-you-shall-out-of-their-own-deeds-receive-reward.

**8:34** For-what-is-man-that-you-should-be-angry-with-him? or-what-is-a-corruptible-race-that-you-should-be-so-bitter-against-it?

**8:35** For-in-truth-there-is-no-one-of-the-earth-born-who-has-not-dealt-wickedly, and-among-the-understanding-there-is-none-who-has-not-sinned.

**8:36** For-in-this, O-LORD, your-righteousness-and-your-goodness-shall-be-declared, if-you-are-merciful-to-them-who-have-no-wealth-of-good-works.

**8:37** Then-he-answered-me and-said: Some-things-you-have-spoken-right and-according-to-your-words-it-shall-be.

**8:38** For-indeed-I-will-not-concern-myself-about-the-creation-of-those-who-have-sinned, or-about-their-death, their-judgment, or-their-destruction;

**8:39** but-I-will-rejoice-over-the-creation-of-the-righteous, over-their-pilgrimage-also, and-the-salvation-and-the-recompense-that-they-shall-receive.

**8:40** As-I-have-spoken, therefore, so-shall-it-be.

**8:41** For-as-the-farmer-sows-many-seeds-in-the-ground and-plants-a-multitude-of-seedlings, and-yet-not-all-which-were-sown-shall-come-up-in-due-season, and-not-all-that-were-planted-shall-take-root: so-also-those-who-are-sown-in-the-world-shall-not-all-be-saved.

**8:42** I-answered and-said: If-I-have-found-grace, let-me-speak.

**8:43** As-the-farmer's-seed, if-it-does-not-come-up, because-it-has-not-received-your-rain-in-due-season, or-if-it-has-been-spoiled-by-too-much-rain — so-perishes-the-man-who-is-formed-by-your-hands-and-is-called-your-own-image, because-he-is-made-like-you; for-whose-sake-you-have-formed-all-things — and-likened-him-to-the-farmer's-seed.

**8:44** Be-not-angry-with-us, but-spare-your-people and-have-mercy-upon-your-inheritance; for-you-have-mercy-upon-your-own-creation.

**8:45** Then-he-answered-me and-said: The-things-that-are-present-are-for-those-who-live-now, and-the-things-that-are-future-for-those-who-shall-live-hereafter.

**8:46** For-you-fall-far-short-of-being-able-to-love-my-creation-more-than-I-love-it; but-you-have-many-times-likened-yourself-unto-the-unrighteous.

**8:47** Let-that-not-be-so! But-even-in-this-you-shall-be-praiseworthy-before-the-Most-High,

**8:48** because-you-have-humbled-yourself, as-is-becoming-for-you, and-have-not-judged-yourself-worthy-to-be-much-glorified-among-the-righteous.

**8:49** For-many-great-miseries-shall-be-done-to-those-who-in-the-last-times-dwell-in-the-world, because-they-have-walked-in-great-pride.

**8:50** But-understand-for-yourself, and-of-such-as-are-like-you-seek-the-glory:

**8:51** for-unto-you-is-paradise-opened, the-tree-of-life-is-planted, the-time-to-come-is-prepared, plenteousness-is-made-ready, a-city-is-builded, and-rest-is-allowed, goodness-is-perfected and-wisdom-is-perfected-beforehand.

**8:52** The-root-of-evil-is-sealed-up-from-you, weakness-and-the-moth-are-hidden-from-you, and-corruption-is-fled-into-oblivion.

**8:53** Sorrows-are-passed-away, and-in-the-end-is-shown-the-treasure-of-immortality.

**8:54** Therefore-ask-not-any-more-questions-concerning-the-multitude-of-those-who-perish.

**8:55** For-when-they-had-opportunity-of-choosing, they-despised-the-Most-High, thought-scorn-of-his-law, and-forsook-his-ways.

**8:56** Moreover-they-have-trodden-down-his-righteous-ones,

**8:57** and-said-in-their-heart-that-there-is-no-God; though-knowing-full-well-that-they-must-die.

**8:58** For-as-the-things-aforesaid-shall-receive-you, so-thirst-and-torment-which-are-prepared-shall-receive-them; for-the-Most-High-willed-not-that-man-should-be-destroyed.

**8:59** But-man-himself-who-is-created-defiled-the-name-of-him-who-made-him, and-was-unthankful-to-him-who-prepared-life-for-him.

**8:60** And-therefore-is-my-judgment-now-at-hand.

**8:61** These-things-have-I-not-shown-unto-all-men, but-unto-thee and-a-few-like-thee. Then-I-answered-and-said:

**8:62** Behold, O-LORD, you-have-now-shown-me-a-multitude-of-the-signs which-you-will-do-in-the-last-times, but-you-have-not-shown-me-at-what-time-you-will-do-them.
